metadata.title: The role of knowledge-rich curricula in promoting deep thinking and complex skill acquisition

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This article is a conceptual review and policy discussion rather than an empirical large-scale assessment analysis. It does not report an analytic sample drawn from PISA/TIMSS/PIRLS microdata, nor does it describe the use of ILSA sampling weights or replicate weights. Because no student-level achievement scores (e.g., PV-based outcomes) are modeled with an ML pipeline, there is no basis to specify which weight variables (e.g., TOTWGT/W_FSTUWT) would be applied. For any future empirical work using PISA/TIMSS/PIRLS microdata, analysts should use the official ILSA sampling weights and replicate-weight procedures recommended by the data provider to obtain population-representative estimates and correct uncertainty under the complex survey design.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: No original ILSA microdata sample is analyzed. The paper discusses findings from prior studies and describes policy changes in specific countries (e.g., Portugal and England) using published external assessment results, but it does not define an analytic subsample from PISA/TIMSS/PIRLS microdata.
